Dana: heads-up — ran into a weird numeric spike in production-like load for paged-attn + fp8. lots of NaNs from softmax on FlashVariantC when batch_size >= 24 and sequence_len ~4096. reproducer below and a quick profile.

Sanjay: thanks — can you paste the minimal repro and the exact error? is this only with nf4 or with e4 as well?

Dana: repro (super minimal):
```
# run against local runtime binary with --attn=paged --kernel=flash_c --quant=fp8
python tools/repro_fp8_softmax.py --model=redwood/llama-7b --seq=4096 --batch=28 --fp8 nf4
```
Log excerpt: `E runtime: softmax overflow -> exp returned inf; writing NaN into attn out; max_logit=121.3`

Miguel: saw something similar on my bench. perf counters from the failing run vs baseline (flash_bf16):
- throughput: -12%
- L2_MISS: +38%
- instructions_retired: ~same
- frontend_stalls: +5%
So not pure compute; memory access pattern changes with paged KV + fused kernel.

Lee: interesting. two things to separate: the numeric overflow itself (softmax impl) and why the hardware path sees larger logits. For the former we should add a stable softmax fallback (log-sum-exp). For the latter I suspect an unchecked accumulation/order change in the fused kernel when using fp8 scaling factors (different exponent bias).

Sanjay: can you show the kernel dispatch flags? maybe kernel selection picked an optimization that skips the exponent clamp for fp8.

Dana: dispatch snippet from the trace: `select_kernel(attn_type=paged, dtype=fp8, prefer=flash_c, kv_prefetch=true) -> flash_c_fused_fp8_fastpath`
Profiler stack (hot):
```
flash_c_fused_fp8_fastpath
softmax_kernel
write_attn_out
kv_page_fill
```
And the metric dump shows max_logit spikes only on >16 batches. single-batch runs are fine.

Lee: quick mitigation proposal:
1) add softmax numeric guard for fp8 fastpath: compute max_logit per-row, and if max_logit - min_logit > 50 or max_logit > 80, either clamp exponents (exp(x - max) with extra clamp), or force fallback to `stable_softmax_kernel` implemented in fp32/bf16 path.
2) change kernel selection heuristics: if attn is paged && dtype==fp8 && batch_sz>16 -> prefer `stable_fused` instead of `flash_c_fused_fp8_fastpath`.
3) add a tiny unit/regression: generate synthetic logits with extreme ranges and assert no NaNs after softmax.

Miguel: sounds good. My bench suggests the fallback costs ~6% throughput but eliminates NaNs. acceptable as a short-term guard. Also will run memory access microbench to see why L2 miss spike correlates.

Sanjay: will we also add runtime telemetry to catch first occurrence (metric: softmax_overflow_count) and an automatic kernel-switchover when count>0 in a minute window? That would prevent customer traffic from seeing NaNs.

Dana: yes please. I can add the telemetry event in the repro branch. Plan: Dana opens PR with repro + telemetry; Lee opens the kernel-fallback PR; Miguel runs the perf sweep and posts artifacts. I'll attach the tiny repro output here once PR is up.

perf-bot: CI fused-bench job #4821 finished (artifact: gs://ci-artifacts/fused-bench/4821) — failing run attached (contains perf counters + traces).

Lee: one more note — fp8 quant requires careful scaling per-head when using paged KV; ensure the per-head scale is recomputed at page boundaries. I suspect the hotpath reuses stale scale leading to large logits. add an invariant check: if scale_change>2x log a warning and force recompute.

Dana: agreed. thanks all — creating issues/PRs now. tagging @Sanjay for the telemetry plan. :thumbsup:
